title: Build parallel lists from snack rows
description: You store each snack's fields at matching positions in separate lists.

steps.description: You prepare names, categories, and prices as empty lists. The file object supplies lines, and rownum tracks the current row.
You split each data row into fields and append each field to its list. float converts the price text to a numeric value.

steps.question: Does rownum increase on the first line even when the if body is skipped?
steps.answer: Yes. The increment sits inside the loop and outside the if body.

steps.description: You close the file and print names and prices. The recording shows snack names in file order and their corresponding numeric prices.
